cards.mechanism: Incremental settled funding cost can change basis-arbitrage incentives; test whether a one-event funding change contains a contrarian price component beyond the funding level. Directional usefulness remains an inference to falsify.
cards.factor: delta_k = settled_rate_k - settled_rate_k_minus_1, only after both declared available_at timestamps; compare only continuous equal-8h-slot events.
cards.independence: No price-breakout/persistence entry, no nonpaying sign gate, no taker-flow condition. Change is not a function of latest funding sign; economic independence remains unverified.
cards.fixed_card_rules: Zero means flat. First hourly boundary strictly after max(available_at_k, available_at_k_minus_1); enter once per newly available event, hold 8h, no averaging/pyramiding; defer event when existing position has not exited. BTC/ETH, 1x, shared 1000 USDT research wallet, 0.4 per pair, 20% position stop, 6bp taker plus 2bp cash slippage each side and exact settlement funding. No sweeps.
cards.falsification: Require complete accounting, positive gross price effect and adequate descriptive sample (30 native position cycles and 12 common 72h entry clusters); net<=0, gross price effect<=0, or no positive incremental net versus level stops this card. Funding receipts alone do not support the directional adjustment hypothesis. Positive remains development-only.
cards.information_value: Tests whether a derivative of funding contributes beyond level/carry without retaining the frozen breakout mechanism.
cards.next_condition: Zero-native development preflight must prove source/period/lag/cost bindings, observed nonzero changes and meaningful level-vs-change decision disagreement without inspecting return labels. Only then freeze a separate two-control execution protocol and request scheduler admission under preserved shared budget/lock; no market task created by this receipt.
